title: Jiang Wei Outthinks the Sleeping Dragon; Wang Lang Dies of an Argument
summary: At Tianshui a young Wei officer anticipates Zhuge Liang's feint and beats it — the first time in the book anyone has. Zhuge Liang takes the city by a forgery specifically to acquire him, and Jiang Wei comes over.

Then the seventy-six-year-old Wang Lang rides out to persuade Shu's army to surrender by force of rhetoric, and is answered so comprehensively — his whole career recited back to him as a list of accommodations — that he falls off his horse dead.
history: Jiang Wei's defection is historical. Wang Lang died in his bed, two years later, of nothing in particular.

pins.note: Anticipates Zhuge Liang, and is recruited for it.
Rides out to win by argument, and dies of losing.
